title: Companion-world catalogue, corrected claims and real agency
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full actual catalogue review; source-specific function, agency, history and proposed starts preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full209-line catalogue actually read. Oversized initial1–105 output was truncated and recovered in bounded1–45/46–65/66–85/86–105;106–209 was reread in bounded chunks. Review includes E1–E4/K1–K3, H01–H11, P01–P18, B01–B13, O01–O06, X01–X04, V01–V05, W/N/D registers, WIKI1–3 and Q1–Q4. This is content review of the catalogue, not new source fetching or a full read of each linked dossier. Root palette current H rows and C1 router already preserve the three corrections and B511 preserves their wider scope, so do not append a second competing correction there.

F2: H audit's8 confirmed/3 corrected verdicts remain historical claim-level attribution. Preserve Jujutsu technique-specific means, ordinary messenger birds with exceptions and uncertain Skyrim ghost-dog identity. Sealing/containment does not prove friendship; contract differs from fusion; sword spirit differs from purchasable independent person; edition-specific familiar, beast companion, mount and summon profiles remain distinct. Dogmeat affinity exception and independent aranea personhood resist a universal loyalty/taming model. No fandom/secondary confirmation becomes official source proof by this reconciliation.

F3: K functions, B acquisition/custody routes and C trust/affection/obedience/understanding/terms/channel/respect axes remain a useful palette rather than permission lists or exhaustive simulation requirements. Body classification does not imply property, command does not prove affection/consent, and control can be coercive without changing its real mechanical effect. A source's actual fixed-loyalty mechanism is not automatically erased by a generic relationship rule. Particular animal, autonomous constructed person, spirit, remnant, projection, controlled body and software assistant retain their actual needs/agency. No universal pet cap, novice start, new weakness, grief penalty or hunger death is selected.

F4: Every priority/novel row separates source-grounded means from proposed adjacent roles, starts and dials. Retain actual spirit terms, body/source access, spell profile, clone/shared reserve, channel range, known care, resource state, custody and era where they matter, without imposing every burden on every companion. Later higher authority can remove old caps and ordinary costs; a lower-era selected excerpt cannot cap all later versions. HP pet intelligence is not generic soul-bond magic; spirit courier call/letter handoff is not delivery proof; a pact-granted faculty need not place its source being on the map. Framework support or a protagonist's power does not grant a fresh entrant that same unique companion or entire future kit.

F5: B08/B09 preserve independently bounded Labyrinth volumes: absence on arrival and later alive independent strand do not prove offscreen reunion. ORV's staged identities, novel/sequel profiles, MTL Paradise recipient aliases and equipment-to-living conversion remain separate. A forced mark does not prove willing friendship; inherited ring custody does not dictate mentor loyalty; a temporary undead operation or guide interface does not certify a pet system. Memory/copy/return rules from B545/B546 qualify each real carrier rather than automatically transporting every ally, reward or friendship. Current PROJECT governs developer-route priority; paused source-game queues remain paused.

F6: Directory V counts are frozen inventory, including16 substantive full-book directories and one duplicate spelling route, not17 independent qualified editions. Motif/template/candidate folders are not worlds. X01–X04 and B10/B11 original pet/start suggestions stay useful unverified canon proposals. N06's direct selected primary check is explicitly historical and narrower than its later dossier-derived AI claims; most other N rows are dossier-mediated. Repaired extraction is not total corpus certification. Old absent EPUB/cache/source-path statements are historical boundaries, not freshly tested access blockers or acquisition authority. Selected earlier Shadow Slave scenes do not certify the later3000-chapter union merely named in metadata.

F7: WIKI1–WIKI3 distinguish indexed text, selected full-page inspection, failed bodies and official material under separate profiles. Preserve that evidence chain; no PDF or external page was opened in this review. Q1 remains an entity-identification issue, Q2 an exact selected-route source check, Q3 a qualified-source gap, Q4 proposal/adoption boundary. They do not block unrelated current work or require all sources before a first useful seam under AD51. No new companion gameplay, asset, actor, save field/migration, acquisition, worker, native UI, commit or human acceptance is claimed.
reviews.evidence: All209 lines read with dense truncated region recovered. Targeted root H/C1/B511 matches confirm corrections already folded; no underlying novel/wiki/PDF reread.
reviews.reopen: Reopen only new content or a selected exact companion/start/source profile; retain useful candidate roles without a universal companion build gate.
